name: Vaultwarden
description: A small Bitwarden-compatible password server, written in Rust.

env.label: Admin page token
env.description: Unlocks /admin, where accounts and the SMTP settings live. Leave it empty to keep the admin page switched off.

env.label: Allow new sign-ups
env.description: Set it to false once your own account exists, so nobody else can register.

env.label: Public URL
env.description: The URL clients reach this server on, including the scheme. Needed for attachments and for WebSocket notifications.

notes: Put this behind HTTPS before you put real passwords in it. Clients refuse to sync over plain HTTP.
